name: ClamAV
description: Antivirus scanning with clamd on your project's private network and automatic freshclam signature updates. Signature databases persist across deployments.

connection.title: Connect to ClamAV
connection.description: Send files to clamd from another service on the project's private network. Its TCP protocol has no authentication or encryption.

guide.intro: The container runs clamd and freshclam together. No port is published to the host or routed to a domain.
guide.useHint: Configure your ClamAV client with the private host and port below. Stream file contents when the files are not mounted in this container.

features.title: Private antivirus scanner
features.description: Connect applications to clamd on the project's private network.

features.title: Persistent signatures
features.description: Freshclam updates the signature databases on a persistent volume.
